Bots Tracker Rules Settings
Settings

Connect

Connect Binance

How to get API keys from Binance

  1. Log into your Binance account.
  2. Go to Account → API Keys.
  3. Click Create API.
  4. Select System generated.
  5. Label your keys (e.g. "deltabadger-tracker") and pass the security verification if necessary.
  6. Keep Enable Reading on (it is by default). It is the only permission the tracker needs — it never places an order or moves funds, so Spot Trading is not needed.
    ⚠️ Important: Do not enable Withdrawals — the key is refused if it can withdraw.
  7. Optional, to tie the key to this machine: click Edit restrictions and whitelist the IP address of the machine where Deltabadger is installed. If running on a server, use the server's public IP. If it's your local computer check your IP here. A reading key works without it.
  8. Copy and paste your new API keys above.
